metadata.description: Plugin marketplace for systemprompt.io: shared infrastructure, development, content, SEO, social media, and CRM

plugins.name: commons
plugins.description: Shared infrastructure: daily master brief (single autonomous entry point with Yesterday Debrief gate, Key Stats headline block, and reports/summary/ trend store), product identity, brand voice, brand review, marketing identity, marketing strategy, marketing briefs, hypothesis ledgers (H-###), CLI reference, and patterns for hypothesis ledgers, strategy documents, and daily briefs used across all domains

plugins.name: development
plugins.description: All development skills for systemprompt.io: Rust backend (extensions, CLI binaries, MCP servers), web features, frontend coding standards, and UX/UI design system (visual design, component patterns, modern CSS, interaction patterns)

plugins.name: content
plugins.description: Content creation and publishing: three writer+optimiser pairs (guides, features, documentation) with research-first workflows, per-content reports, and deterministic audit scoring. Feature writer+optimiser now enforce Technical-Marketing Synthesis (Rule 6: outcome headlines, jargon payoff, numbers with context, feature-to-outcome binding, narrative-vs-reference separation, skeptic test) on top of Why-What-How. Daily content brief, content hypothesis ledger (CT-###), content strategy master, image generation, multi-channel distribution (Dev.to, Medium, LinkedIn, Reddit, email), and end-to-end publishing via CLI

plugins.name: seo
plugins.description: Search engine optimisation: daily SEO brief (renamed from seo-monitor), DataForSEO keyword tracking, hypothesis-driven SEO testing (S-### ledger), AI agent answer-engine optimisation (AEO), and living strategy document maintenance

plugins.name: social-media
plugins.description: Social media engagement: LinkedIn posting and DM outreach, three-skill Reddit pipeline (audience-finder for subreddit qualification, monitor for daily opportunity scanning, post-composer for genuine non-marketing posts), X/Twitter threads, cross-platform coordination, and daily social brief

plugins.name: crm
plugins.description: Pipeline management: daily CRM briefs, CRM strategy document, hypothesis-driven action tracking (C-### ledger), pipeline state tracking, lead-tracker funnel measurement (now including crates.io download counts), world-class lead enrichment (7 data sources: Gmail, GitHub, WebSearch, company website, email domain, internal cross-ref, analytics), and email outreach via Resend API
